text: Seabrook Town launches a swift counter-attack from just beyond the halfway line near their own 59-metre mark. Elias Haddad sends a long pass down the left flank to Callum Varga, who immediately crosses into the right side of Harbour City's penalty area. Tomas Kowalski collects the ball close to the right edge of the penalty box and plays a quick, short pass to Kian Romano, positioned about 3 metres from goal on Harbour City's left side. Romano shoots with his foot and scores, putting Seabrook Town ahead 4-2 in the final moments of the match. [#1901] [#1902] [#1903] [#1904] [#1906]
